description: Create a new Cloud Cache config group. cloudCacheVersion combines engine version and mode (e.g. '8.1.6-simple' = Standalone, '7.2.11-cluster' = Cluster) — list valid values with ncloud_list_cache_config_group_versions. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

configGroupName.description: Config group name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen; must start with a letter and end with a letter or number)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the config group

name: ncloud_create_cache_config_group
